_: Boxes in design pt, x0 y0 x1 y1, on the capture named first. gen.py's cut() multiplies by SCALE (3.0 capture px per pt) and writes assets/art/<id>.png. p1, p5 and p10 are read through gen.py's INPAINT: the chrome the boards draw again in CSS is patched out of the capture with a Coons fill before the crop is taken.
_rule: Only a picture is cropped. Every rule, fill, glyph and run of type on these screens is rebuilt, so nothing here carries interface pixels -- 10's hero keeps its own baked-in scrim but has X's 'LIVE' and event title patched out of it. The three facepiles are one rectangle each, white gaps included, because the discs overlap. The two banners and the avatar are not here: 06, 07 and 10 show the example account's own, which are in assets/ and placed by pic().
